svg.title: 03 · PlateHunter — Iranian license-plate recognition
svg.desc: Project card: a camera frame is scanned, YOLO proposes and locks the plate, a second YOLO finds eight characters, ConvNeXt classifies each crop, the DD L DDD DD format and geometric-mean confidence are validated, and a Kalman filter tracks the plate across frames.

g.text: Iranian ALPR built as explicit stages —
